scope: Florida state transportation regulations and state-specific Florida Medicaid requirements; not a complete inventory of all state, local, contract or vehicle-class obligations
source_verification: Primary authoritative statutes and AHCA/FDOT/CTD rule metadata reviewed, plus official AHCA PDF policy; individual citation_text quotation exact-match to cited_url was not automatically verified across all rules. Do not treat as production-ready.
import_guidance: Treat all rules with needs as waiting. Do not enforce until all applicability facts and evidence evaluators exist; treat uncovered conditional requirements separately.
notes: Florida Medicaid file adds state-specific rules, it does not duplicate the national Medicaid statutory floor.
FDOT Chapter 14-90 only for covered bus transit and private contractor operations per F.S. 341.061.
CTD Chapter 41-2.006 only for coordinated transportation-disadvantaged operations; local service plan defines CPR/first aid/background rules.
Florida Medicaid NEMT driver screening is Level 1 or approved equivalent, not a universal Level 2 mandate.
AHCA Appendix C insurance $100k/$200k and CTD insurance $200k/$300k refer to different scopes.
Ongoing trip medical necessity, beneficiary eligibility, time limits, and local ordinances require new trip/operational facts.
For 2026 Florida statutes historical effective dates are provisionally marked 2026-11-07, and may not support historical trips; verify specific session law before enabling retrospectively.
Ordinary taxi/limousine licensing and county ordinances are not uniformly statewide and are not included.
Current schema does not include trip as a subject; trip obligations are represented under company and flagged with needs.
